parts.name: Foot Pad
parts.Basic_description: The foot pad of the trashcan is a small rectangular component made of durable plastic, located at the bottom front of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the pedal that users press with their foot to open the lid without using their hands, providing hygienic operation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring or lever mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a flat, hinged cover made of plastic that fits on top of the trashcan body.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the opening of the trashcan to contain odors and conceal waste, opening automatically when the foot pad is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward around a hinge axis when the pedal is pressed and closes by gravity or spring tension.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the trashcan, typically rectangular and made of stainless steel for durability and easy cleaning.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the trash bag and provides structural support for the lid and pedal mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the fixed housing for the moving parts.
